modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On December 30, 2005: Tropical Storm Zeta forms in the open Atlantic Ocean, tying the record for the latest tropical cyclone ever to form in the North Atlantic basin.

did_you_know.fact: On December 30, 1927: The Ginza Line, the first subway line in Asia, opens in Tokyo, Japan.
On December 30, 1896: Canadian ice hockey player Ernie McLea scores the first hat-trick in Stanley Cup play, and the Cup-winning goal as the Montreal Victorias defeat the Winnipeg Victorias 6–5.

December 30 is observed as The sixth of the Twelve Days of Christmas (Western Christianity).
